## File: facebookresearch_digit360/digit360/interface/control/led.py

Prompts

```
['create a function that turns off all LED channels on a Digit360 device by sending a reset message', "create a function that sets an LED channel's RGB color on a Digit360 device and returns the message", 'review the led_all_off function to understand how it sends a CHANNEL_ALL_RESET lighting control message', 'review the led_set_channel function to understand how it constructs and sends RGB lighting control messages', 'summarize the LED control module that provides functions to turn off all LEDs or set individual channel colors']
```

Usage

```
{'led_all_off': 'create a function that turns off all LED channels on a Digit360 device by sending a reset message', 'led_set_channel': "create a function that sets an LED channel's RGB color on a Digit360 device and returns the message", 'review_led_all_off': 'review the led_all_off function to understand how it sends a CHANNEL_ALL_RESET lighting control message', 'review_led_set_channel': 'review the led_set_channel function to understand how it constructs and sends RGB lighting control messages', 'summarize_led_control': 'summarize the LED control module that provides functions to turn off all LEDs or set individual channel colors'}
```
